scope: Tested installed Titanfall 2 build; RVAs are not portable across updates.

limits.name: world_draw_batches
limits.evidence: engine.dll RVA 0xb7304; static keys can be split by dynamic light masks

limits.name: world_mesh_reference_index
limits.evidence: OBJ_REFERENCES uint16; references index meshes, not source prop placements

limits.name: local_vertex_index
limits.evidence: MESH_INDICES uint16; global vertex base lives in MATERIAL_SORTS

limits.name: collision_primitive_index
limits.evidence: CM_PRIMITIVES bits 8..23; target brush or triangle header; conservative writers use fewer than 65536

limits.name: geoset_start_and_count
limits.evidence: CM_GRID_CELLS uint16 fields; range first+count checked conservatively <=65535

limits.name: packed_collision_center_and_extent
limits.evidence: CM_GEO_SET_BOUNDS / CM_PRIMITIVE_BOUNDS / TRICOLL_NODES; require center and extent to fit, not just coordinates

limits.name: flat_cell_child_and_leaf_counts
limits.evidence: CELL_AABB_NODES; build_camera_visibility also restricts root child count <=255

limits.name: project_world_index_policy
limits.evidence: build_phase_runner_firs.py; margin, not an engine hard limit

limits.name: project_static_batch_policy
limits.evidence: Firs release requires static_batch_runs <512; dynamic lights can multiply batch count

limits.name: project_local_vertices_policy
limits.evidence: optimize_portalfree_render.py; preserves short local clipping spans

limits.name: project_tricoll_group_triangles
limits.evidence: native_triangle_collision.py supports 1..300; 96 chosen to keep compact local bounds

limits.name: project_coordinate_clip
limits.evidence: rebuild_complete_collision.py; remote polygons clipped; shape bounds must still be representable

current_release.limitation: This audits a native world-rendering capacity. It does not prove which meshes the running client marks visible or account for earlier index-buffer use in the frame. Static models use a different rendering path.
